description: This source file implements network status monitoring for Linux using netlink sockets, including a thread that detects IP address changes and notifies the application about network connectivity status.

classes.name: NetworkNotifier
classes.description: A class responsible for initializing and managing a thread that monitors network status changes via netlink socket events.

methods.name: GetOnlineStatus
methods.description: Checks kernel messages for IP address changes and updates the online status accordingly.

methods.name: NetworkNotifier::NotifierThreadEntry
methods.description: Thread entry point that waits for network events and updates application state.
